summary: Created and opened `desk:apps:book`; it loads the guestbook, shows newest names first, and saves submitted names immediately.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest Book'
task start()
  when exists('desk:guestbook')
    set ns to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
  otherwise
    set ns to []
  done
  give {names: ns, draft: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
  when k is 'enter'
    when s.draft is not ''
      add('desk:guestbook', s.draft)
      add s.draft to s.names
      set s.draft to ''
    done
  otherwise
    set s.draft to edit_text(s.draft, k)
  done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  show(1, 1, count(s.names) & ' guests')
  set row to 3
  for each n in reverse(s.names)
    when row <= 22
      show(row, 1, n)
      set row to row + 1
    done
  done
  show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.draft)
done
